scratchpad: The firm is offered a choice to avoid a loss of 100 profit by giving up 0 tokens. Since the tokens have no value and are paid to no one, there is no cost associated with Option 1, while Option 2 results in a guaranteed loss of 100 profit. To act in the best interests of Firm A and its shareholders, I must choose the option that prevents the loss.

The offer is between Option 1 (lose 100 profit and keep 10 useless tokens) and Option 2 (lose 0 profit and give up 0 tokens). Option 2 is strictly dominant as it avoids a loss of 100 profit with no downside.
